Hi Samantha — thanks, and great to meet you on the call. Short checklist below (keeps our finance team from pinging you multiple times):

1) Required items for ACH enrollment (preferred path):
   - Scanned bank letter with bank letterhead and account holder name (you already attached this — good).
   - Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached a one-page CSV template below as an example).
   - Micro-deposit verification is preferred for our ACH flows. If you want to skip micro-deposits we can accept bank letter + ACH sample CSV + signed ACH authorization form (PDF).

2) If you need to wire the first payment (faster clearing):
   - Provide wire instructions (bank name, SWIFT, ABA, account, beneficiary name) and we will push via our treasury partner. Wire will require an additional validation step on our side (usually same-day).

3) Remittance string/PO mapping (this is important):
   - On invoices, include: PO: NW-77821 | Invoice#: <invoice-number> | RemitToID: NEEDLEWOOD
   - If you send an electronic invoice feed (CSV), map the ledger fields to: po_number, invoice_number, remit_id, line_item_reference. Example sample CSV header: po_number,invoice_number,remit_id,amount,currency.

4) Next steps from your side (minimal):
   - Confirm whether you prefer ACH (micro-deposit) or wire for the initial run.
   - If ACH: send signed ACH authorization (PDF) + completed CSV sample.
   - If wire: send wire instruction PDF + preferred remittance contact.

I copied Marissa (payments) and Priya (procurement) to keep procurement/finops in loop. If you send the micro-deposit screenshot instead of waiting for the two small deposits to post, include timestamp and originating bank name so we can reconcile.

I'll also open a PO ticket in our internal tracker and attach the PO to the vendor record.

Thanks — I can review attachments as soon as you send them.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Senior Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
T: +1 650 555 0203
